sentences.text: The provided record does not support a 5% pre-payment charge for a gold loan; the only in-force charge figures shown are 2% or 3% of principal outstanding in the home-loan agreement, while the gold-loan document shown only states a tenure of up to 12 months.

For this UCB, the in-force rule for cases outside the specific pre-payment-charge prohibitions says that pre-payment charges, if any, shall be as per the approved policy of a UCB, and the record does not include any gold-loan policy or sanction document showing a 5% rate.

missing.searched: Reviewed the provided gold-loan FAQ, the home-loan agreement, and the UCB pre-payment-charge directions; no gold-loan document or policy showing a 5% pre-payment charge was found.
